'''James Bottomley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 San Diego Comic-Con Open]] on 21 July 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course Manipulator]], according to Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1026">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-23-2000-sd-comiccon-tr-by-clayton-atkind1026/ 2000-sd-comiccon-tr-by-clayton-atkin], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 23 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-23-2000-sd-comiccon-tr-by-clayton-atkind1026/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
